scientific.claim: For perfect nine-ary length-four two-deletion-correcting codes, sizes \(16\) and \(17\) occur. Consequently, \(\{16,17,18,19\}\subseteq \operatorname{Spec}(9,4,2)\subseteq\{14,15,16,17,18,19\}\), so relative to the published 2010 bounds and constructions only sizes \(14\) and \(15\) remain undecided in the \(q=9\) spectrum.
scientific.integrity: The two new spectrum memberships are proved by explicit complete codeword lists whose two-deletion descendant sets are deterministically checked to partition all 81 ordered pairs.
limitations: The result proves existence only at sizes 16 and 17; it does not decide whether sizes 14 or 15 occur.
The explicit certificates concern only alphabet size 9, word length 4, and two deletions.
Bibliographic searches cannot exclude an obscure or unindexed earlier construction.

title: Two missing spectrum members for perfect nine-ary length-four two-deletion codes
